title: Check request fields
responsibility: Checks basic request objects, text, identifiers, choices and normalized image regions.

inputs.name: ipcFields.value
inputs.description: The value expected to be a non-null object other than an array.

inputs.name: textField.value
inputs.description: The value expected to be a nonblank string.

inputs.name: textField.max
inputs.description: The maximum text length; defaults to 300 characters.

inputs.name: textField.pattern
inputs.description: An optional regular expression the text must match.

inputs.name: nullableText.value
inputs.description: Either null or a nonblank string of at most 300 characters. Undefined is not accepted as null.

inputs.name: nullableText.pattern
inputs.description: An optional pattern for non-null text.

inputs.name: enumField.value
inputs.description: The value to select from an allowed list.

inputs.name: enumField.allowed
inputs.description: The exact values permitted for the selection.

inputs.name: regionField.value
inputs.description: Either null or an image rectangle with finite x, y, width and height fractions from 0 to 1. Width and height must be positive and the rectangle must stay inside the image, allowing a 0.000001 edge tolerance.

outputs.name: ipcFields
outputs.description: The original object, without filtering its keys or copying it.

outputs.name: textField
outputs.description: The original accepted string, without trimming it.

outputs.name: nullableText
outputs.description: Null for null input, otherwise the accepted string.

outputs.name: hashPattern
outputs.description: A pattern for exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

outputs.name: commitPattern
outputs.description: A pattern for exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

outputs.name: idPattern
outputs.description: A pattern for lowercase letter-or-digit segments separated by dots or hyphens.

outputs.name: versionPattern
outputs.description: A pattern for v followed by at least three decimal digits.

outputs.name: enumField
outputs.description: The supplied value when it exactly matches an allowed entry.

outputs.name: regionField
outputs.description: Null or a new rectangle containing only x, y, width and height.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws when an object, text field, identifier, allowed choice or image region fails its check.
